sourceSummary: Posts and users endpoints of the JSONPlaceholder API.

testCases.title: Listing posts returns a non-empty collection

steps.expectedObservation: The response status is 200 and the response body is an array

testCases.rationale: The catalogue endpoint returning 200 with an empty array looks healthy to a monitor but is a total outage to a caller.

testCases.title: Fetching a known post returns that post
testCases.expectedResult: The response body has field "id" equal to 1 and the response body has a "title" field.
testCases.rationale: Catches an off-by-one in id lookup that returns a neighbouring record — the status code stays 200 while the data is wrong.

testCases.title: Fetching the comments on a post returns a collection

steps.expectedObservation: The response status is 200 and the response body is an array

testCases.rationale: Catches a broken join on the nested route, which typically returns an empty array rather than an error.

testCases.title: Creating a post echoes the submitted fields with a new id
testCases.expectedResult: The response body has field "title" equal to "generated" and the response body has a "id" field.
testCases.rationale: Catches a create that returns 201 while silently dropping or mangling the submitted fields.

testCases.title: An unknown post id is refused rather than guessed at
testCases.rationale: Catches an unknown id falling through to a 200 with an empty body, which a client cannot distinguish from a real record.

testCases.title: Post id zero is treated as not found, not as a falsy default
testCases.rationale: Zero is the classic falsy-id bug: a truthiness check on the id treats 0 as absent and can return the whole collection or the first record instead of a 404.

testCases.title: An unknown user id is refused
testCases.rationale: Confirms the not-found path is wired on the users route too, not just on posts.

testCases.title: Filtering posts by author returns a usable collection
preconditions: User 1 has authored at least one post

steps.expectedObservation: The response status is 200 and the response body is an array

testCases.rationale: Catches an unrecognised query parameter being ignored — the endpoint returns 200 with every post, which looks correct until you count them.

testCases.title: A user record does not leak credential material
testCases.expectedResult: The response body has a "email" field and the response body does not contain "password".
testCases.rationale: Catches a serializer that returns the whole user row, exposing a password hash to any caller who can read a profile.

testCases.title: A single post is served well within the latency budget
testCases.expectedResult: The response is returned in under 500 milliseconds.
testCases.rationale: Catches a missing index on the posts table, which shows up as latency long before it shows up as an error.
